note: Prefer device color spaces for variable text (#475). Port: content.rs, graphics/color.rs, tests. The field active_variable_text stays false, because the base port leaves out start_variable_text and the forms (D62). The parts of interactive/form.rs, the comment of serialize.rs on the output intents and the snapshot forms_prefer_device_color are not ported

Prefer Option in setters for form fields and annotations (#480). It changes the setters of the form fields in interactive/form.rs and of the widget annotations in interactive/annotation.rs, with examples/forms.rs and the tests of the forms. The base port leaves out the forms and the widget annotations (D62)
Ignore empty document languages (#481). Port: interchange/metadata.rs
Paint nothing for gradients without stops (#483). Port: content.rs, graphics/paint.rs, tests. pdf no longer records ErrPDFInvalidGradient for a gradient with no stop (D66)

Add the Trapped key to metadata (#478). Port: interchange/metadata.rs, tests, the snapshots metadata_full and metadata_custom_fields. The XMP metadata is not ported (D62), so neither are the key pdf:Trapped and the snapshots with XMP or with the validators of PDF/A
Show the font name in Font's Debug output and font errors (#482). Port: error.rs, text/font.rs. The impl Debug for Font becomes Font.String
Adjust example to make use of the re-export of usvg in krilla-svg (#484). It changes only crates/krilla-svg/examples/svg.rs, an example that okage does not port

Support writing custom XMP metadata (#486). Port: the doc comments of interchange/metadata/mod.rs, which was interchange/metadata.rs. The rest writes and checks custom XMP properties, with the validators of PDF/A, the XMP metadata and the embedded files, which the base port leaves out (D62). So the modules custom.rs, extension_schema.rs, predefined.rs, relax_ng.rs and xmp.rs, the changes of configure/validate.rs, error.rs, chunk_container.rs, interchange/embed.rs, serialize.rs and PDF_A4.md, the tests of tests/src/metadata.rs and the seven snapshots are not ported. The new crate xmlwriter and the new rev of xmp-writer serve only this code

Use a gray transparency group for gradient opacity masks (#488). Port: content.rs, graphics/graphic.rs, graphics/mask.rs, graphics/xobject.rs, interactive/annotation.rs, text/type3.rs, tests, the snapshot pattern_linear_gradient_with_opacity_icc. The Option<GroupColorSpace> becomes a groupColorSpace whose zero value is None. The masks of the mesh gradients of okage keep the RGB group. The snapshot graphic_svg is not ported, because okage has no test graphic_svg. The images of refs/visreg are not ported
Fix size of generated PDF in krilla-svg example (#485). It changes only crates/krilla-svg/examples/svg.rs, an example that okage does not port
Fix compiler warnings (#489). It removes an unused import from interactive/annotation.rs, with no change of behavior

Bump CI Rust version to 1.100 (#490). It changes the CI, and writes chunks_exact_mut as as_chunks_mut in deflate_image_channels of graphics/image/mod.rs, with the same behavior. The Go code does not change

Include the license files in the published crates (#495). It adds links to the MIT and Apache licenses in crates/krilla and crates/krilla-svg. pdf/LICENSE and pdfsvg/LICENSE already hold the MIT license of krilla
